method: Three end-to-end paths include hex input and hex public-key output. CPU time counts all process threads. CPU worker excludes IPC from its reported execution time; hybrid includes command/result IPC. Hybrid partitions fixture ranges and checks each range in its owning process; public-key vectors are not transferred to the parent or merged there. Prepacked GPU excludes packing/output conversion and is not end-to-end. No node integration, RLP, Keccak, EVM, disk, networking or consensus. Startup, signing, compilation, correctness checks and warmup excluded. Each trial randomizes backends with seed 20261020.
